Players Committee card image of [[Marquand In Blizzard 6]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Marquand, who provides ability of 2. Cards Blizzard 6 hits are power and forfeit -2 and may not apply ability towards drawing battle destiny. Immune to attrition < 4.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/marquandinblizzard6.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/marquandinblizzard6.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
